title: Confidentiality and integrity in transit need per-link deployment evidence
remediation: Component maintainers and deployment communications owners map every assessed link, TLS termination, loopback exception and any end-to-end protection layer. Collect effective protocol and trust settings plus accepted and refused peer or integrity results for the selected cryptographic mechanism. Treat built-in TLS and G13 platform attestation as scoped inputs and record explicit inheritance and exceptions.

milestones.title: Collect assessed flow and termination inventory with configuration and connection verification for each applicable transit protection
